title: MyDifficulty
description: This project allows players to choose the difficulty they want to play from, between three presets
body:
This plugin adds per-player difficulty settings that are chosen on joining of a server. The three difficulties are:
GREEN
- Take damage from mobs roughly equivalent to easy vanilla difficulty
- Only lose 10% of your items on death
  
YELLOW
- Take damage from mobs roughly equivalent to normal vanlla difficulty
  
RED
- Take normal hard difficulty damage

Setup:
- Install the plugin and set your server to hard difficulty "/difficulty hard".

Players with permissions can override the difficulty chosen by other players with /setdifficulty <player> <colour>
